name: i_am_that_i_am
description: The divine self-declaration Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh (Exodus 3:14) — quintessential self-referential statement of being. Perfect Frobenius closure: the utterance is identical to what it declares.

name: eat_of_my_body_drink_of_my_blood
description: The Eucharistic command — transubstantiation, consuming the divine body and blood. Ingestion/internalization of the divine substance.
